pack.title: Tipping & checkout pressure
pack.description: The tipped tablet turn. Tip for service, not for being watched.

scenarios.setting: Counter pickup. The cashier flips the tablet: 25%, 30%, 35%.
scenarios.jab: It's just going to ask you a quick question.

replies.line: I'll choose my own amount. Thank you.
replies.why: It states your payment choice without criticizing the cashier.
replies.delivery: Choose on the screen as you speak; keep “thank you” ordinary and warm.

replies.why: It keeps the decision brief and courteous.
replies.delivery: Say “I'll choose” clearly, then stop instead of adding a defense. Choose on the screen as you speak.

replies.line: I'll pass on this one — appreciate you though.
replies.why: Thanks plus a clear no keeps the human moment intact while your wallet stays shut.
replies.delivery: Keep “I'll pass on this one” warm and unhurried; finish the request clearly. Choose on the screen as you speak.

replies.line: The tablet has suggestions; I have a budget.
replies.why: Humor separates a suggested amount from your own decision.
replies.delivery: Keep “The tablet has suggestions” light; let the joke stand without repeating it. Choose on the screen as you speak.

trap.line: This tipping stuff is out of control, honestly.
trap.why: It replaces a specific request with accusation, resentment, or an excuse, making your actual boundary less clear.

scenarios.goal: Make your tipping choice without lecturing the cashier.

followUp.jab: You can choose one of these percentages.
followUp.line: I'll select my own amount. Thank you.
followUp.why: It keeps the decision with you and avoids turning a payment screen into a debate.
followUp.delivery: Choose on the screen as you speak; keep “thank you” ordinary and warm.

scenarios.setting: Restaurant. The server hovers while you split the bill with friends.
scenarios.jab: Just so you know, the machine adds eighteen percent automatically.

replies.line: Thank you. I'll check the included charge before deciding.
replies.why: It verifies the bill before treating any additional tip as a separate choice.
replies.delivery: Read the bill first, speak evenly, and avoid claiming an included fee always reaches staff.

replies.line: I'll check that charge first. Thanks.
replies.why: It pauses the decision until the included amount is clear.
replies.delivery: Read the bill first, speak evenly, and avoid claiming an included fee always reaches staff.

replies.line: Thanks for pointing it out; could you explain what the included charge covers?
replies.why: It requests clarification without assuming how the charge is allocated.
replies.delivery: Read the bill first, speak evenly, and avoid claiming an included fee always reaches staff.

replies.line: My calculator wants a moment with the bill.
replies.why: The joke gives you space to review the total without blaming staff.
replies.delivery: Read the bill first, speak evenly, and avoid claiming an included fee always reaches staff.

scenarios.goal: Check an included charge before adding another tip.

followUp.jab: You can still leave extra if you want.
followUp.line: Thank you; I'll review the included amount before deciding.
followUp.why: It clarifies that an additional tip is a separate choice.
followUp.delivery: Read the bill first, speak evenly, and avoid claiming an included fee always reaches staff.
